name: eval
cmd: set -e; export BLR_DEVICE=cuda BLR_MAX_ITER=100 BLR_STARTS=0.5; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_res121 --out {out}/res_s1_t1995 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev --save-species; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_res121_late --out {out}/res_s1_t1985_late --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev --save-species; {python} -c "import numpy as np; a=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_res121/keys.npy'); b=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1/keys.npy'); print('keys desk_tempho_1995_s1_res121 vs desk_tempho_1995_s1:', a.shape, b.shape, 'IDENTICAL' if a.shape==b.shape and (a==b).all() else 'DIFFER')"; {python} -c "import numpy as np; a=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_res121/keys.npy'); b=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2/keys.npy'); print('keys desk_tempho_1995_s2_res121 vs desk_tempho_1995_s2:', a.shape, b.shape, 'IDENTICAL' if a.shape==b.shape and (a==b).all() else 'DIFFER')"; {python} -c "import numpy as np; a=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_res121_late/keys.npy'); b=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_late/keys.npy'); print('keys desk_tempho_1995_s2_res121_late vs desk_tempho_1995_s2_late:', a.shape, b.shape, 'IDENTICAL' if a.shape==b.shape and (a==b).all() else 'DIFFER')"; {python} -c "import numpy as np; a=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_res121/keys.npy'); b=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1/keys.npy'); print('keys desk_tempho_1985_s1_res121 vs desk_tempho_1985_s1:', a.shape, b.shape, 'IDENTICAL' if a.shape==b.shape and (a==b).all() else 'DIFFER')"; {python} -c "import numpy as np; a=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_res121_late/keys.npy'); b=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_late/keys.npy'); print('keys desk_tempho_1985_s1_res121_late vs desk_tempho_1985_s1_late:', a.shape, b.shape, 'IDENTICAL' if a.shape==b.shape and (a==b).all() else 'DIFFER')"; {python} -c "import numpy as np; a=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s2_res121_late/keys.npy'); b=np.load('{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s2_late/keys.npy'); print('keys desk_tempho_1985_s2_res121_late vs desk_tempho_1985_s2_late:', a.shape, b.shape, 'IDENTICAL' if a.shape==b.shape and (a==b).all() else 'DIFFER')"; {python} research/exp/species_strata.py --similarity {outroot}/E067/composition-d2e6a98f0eb7/species_similarity.csv --species-filter {code}/research/E071/eval_species_B.txt --level --runs {out}/res_s1_t1995 {out}/res_s1_t1995_late {out}/res_s2_t1995 {out}/res_s2_t1995_late {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s1_t1995 {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s1_t1995_late {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s2_t1995 {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s2_t1995_late --contrast res_s1_t1995:s1_t1995 --contrast res_s1_t1995_late:s1_t1995_late --contrast res_s2_t1995:s2_t1995 --contrast res_s2_t1995_late:s2_t1995_late --out {out}/strata_t1995.json; {python} research/exp/species_strata.py --similarity {outroot}/E067/composition-d2e6a98f0eb7/species_similarity.csv --species-filter {code}/research/E071/eval_species_B.txt --level --runs {out}/res_s1_t1985 {out}/res_s1_t1985_late {out}/res_s2_t1985 {out}/res_s2_t1985_late {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s1_t1985 {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s1_t1985_late {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s2_t1985 {outroot}/E059/sedentary-verify-a63962b77659/s2_t1985_late --contrast res_s1_t1985:s1_t1985 --contrast res_s1_t1985_late:s1_t1985_late --contrast res_s2_t1985:s2_t1985 --contrast res_s2_t1985_late:s2_t1985_late --out {out}/strata_t1985.json
summarize: grep -E 'keys |CONTRAST|sedentary|resident |all |migratory' {out}/../log.txt 2>/dev/null | head -5; for t in 1995 1985; do echo == $t; python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{out}/strata_t'+'$t'+'.json')); [print(c, s, {w: round(v['diff'],3) for w,v in o.items()}) for c,d in r.get('contrasts',{}).items() for s,o in d.items() if s in ('sedentary','resident','all','migratory')]"; done
note: E071 eval: resident-community DESK vs current DESK (same seeds) on half-B out-of-community species, by stratum
